@@U04669@@
but try, won't you, a smile, just one, one smile, one I'll never forget! A lover’s look, don’t you know, a little, very little twist of the mouth. Oh, you long-legged beauty you, it’s you I like best! Except that clerical look; it doesn’t suit you. Try something a soupcon more lascivious. And you all could show a bit more flesh; those long pleated robes, ah! are much too moral. They're turning! Ah, the rascals! Ah! A view from the rear! From behind, ah, they’re far, far too delectable!

@@U04671@@
Flames of love, hasten, Grow ever clearer; To the self-damned Bring holiness nearer, So that from evil They may be free, And in the Great Unity Transformed may be.

@@U04673@@
(Pulling himself together.)

@@U04674@@
What’s happened to me? All over me, boils, boils head to foot, like Job! I shudder at the sight! And yet— and yet I triumph, seeing through it all, and put trust in myself and my family tree! This Devil’s noble parts are still intact.
translation:
@@U04669@@
但请尝试一下，不是吗，一个微笑，就一个，一个微笑，一个我永远不会忘记的微笑！恋人的表情，你不知道吗，嘴角有一点点、非常轻微的扭曲。哦，长腿美女你，我最喜欢的就是你了！除了那副文书的样子；它不适合你。尝试一些更淫荡的汤。你们都可以多露一点肉；那些长褶袍，啊！太道德了。他们转身了！啊，无赖们！啊!从后面看的景色！从后面看，啊，实在是太美味了！

@@U04671@@
爱的火焰，加速， 变得更加清晰；让那些自责的人更接近圣洁，这样他们就可以从邪恶中解脱出来，并在大统一中得到转变。

@@U04673@@
（振作起来。）

@@U04674@@
我怎么了？我浑身上下都长满了疮，从头到脚都长满了疮，就像约伯一样！看得我不寒而栗！然而——然而我胜利了，看穿了这一切，并相信自己和我的家谱！这个恶魔的高贵部分还完好无损。
